resource.name: SpottedFeverRickettsiosisDisordersSNOMED
resource.title: Spotted Fever Rickettsiosis (Disorders) (SNOMED)
resource.publisher: Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists Steward
resource.description:
The Spotted fever group - SPG contains bacteria recognized as human pathogens: R. rickettsii, R. conorii, R. africae, R. sibirica, R. japonica, R. honei, R. parkeri, R. massiliae, R. monacensis, R. slovaca, R. aeschlimannii, and R. helvetica.  R. rickettsia and R. parkeri are endemic to North America. (MCM).

Transitional group:
- R. australis
- R. akari
- R. felis

Spotted fever group rickettsioses (spotted fevers) in the United States include: (CDC RMSF) 
- Rickettsia parkeri rickettsiosis, caused by R. parkeri; 
- Pacific Coast tick fever, caused by Rickettsia philipii; 
- Rickettsialpox, caused by Rickettsia akari.

resource.title: Extended Timing Threshold Trigger Codes for Public Health Reporting
resource.publisher: CSTE Steward
resource.description: Composite trigger code grouping for the extended-timebox carve-out. Contains both laboratory observation test names (LOINC) and diagnosis/problem codes (SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM) for the conditions whose reportability timebox extends from the standard 30 days to 365 days (slow-manifesting or long-latency evidence). Composition is the union of the per-condition Lab Obs Test Name (S4) and Diagnosis_Problem (S1) value sets for the listed SNOMED condition codes. Membership controls timebox duration for both trigger surfaces — the negative-value exclusion filter still applies to the lab-result branch; the verification-status exclusion still applies to the condition branch. Source: ETI-DRAFT eRSD Optimization II Timing Filter Survey Results, Appendix A (76 SNOMED codes across 72 conditions).
resource.purpose: Trigger codes (both lab-test names and disease codes) whose observations or diagnoses are reportable within a 365-day window rather than the standard 30 days. Used by eCR PlanDefinitions to route selected labs and problems through an extended-timebox branch.

resource.description: Purpose: Clinical Focus - This set of values contains organism and substance names received in a laboratory results report, that may represent that the patient has a potentially reportable condition. These pertain to resulted laboratory reports, where the test method is a non-specific test (e.g., general cultures not specific to a condition) and the result value, coded in SNOMED, includes the organism or substance name. Purpose: Data Element Scope - Nominal laboratory result values documented in a clinical record. Purpose: Inclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Purpose: Exclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Note - Includes codes from selected value sets used in the Reportable Condition Knowledge Management System (RCKMS) reporting logic. RCKMS value sets in VSAC are for informational use only. When implementing trigger codes for electronic case reporting, use the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) file.

resource.description: Purpose: Clinical Focus - This set of values contains laboratory observation test names that may represent that the patient may have a potentially reportable condition. These pertain to resulted laboratory reports, where the lab test name, coded in LOINC, is specific to a reportable condition. Purpose: Data Element Scope - Laboratory test names used in observations documented in a clinical record. Purpose: Inclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Purpose: Exclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Note - Includes codes from selected value sets used in the Reportable Condition Knowledge Management System (RCKMS) reporting logic. RCKMS value sets in VSAC are for informational use only. When implementing trigger codes for electronic case reporting, use the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) file.

resource.description: Purpose: Clinical Focus - This set of values contains laboratory test names that may be used for placing a lab order for a test that represents that the patient may have a potentially reportable condition. These pertain to laboratory orders placed, coded in LOINC, where the lab order includes at least one test for a condition reportable upon suspicion of the condition. Purpose: Data Element Scope - Laboratory test names used in orders documented in a clinical record. Purpose: Inclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Purpose: Exclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Note - Includes codes from selected value sets used in the Reportable Condition Knowledge Management System (RCKMS) reporting logic. RCKMS value sets in VSAC are for informational use only. When implementing trigger codes for electronic case reporting, use the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) file.

text.div:
Id: us-ecr-specification
Url: US eCR Specification
Version: 3.2.0
Title: US eCR Specification
Type:

system: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/plan-definition-type

code: workflow-definition

display: Workflow Definition

Date: 2026-07-08 15:23:06-0600
Publisher: Association of Public Health Laboratories (APHL)
Description:

An eRSD PlanDefinition which includes the queries necessary for producing both CDA eICR R1.1 and CDA eICR R3.1 reports.
Jurisdiction: US
Effective Period: 2026-12-01..
Related Artifacts:

Dependencies

  • http://ersd.aimsplatform.org/fhir/Library/rctc|3.2.0
Actions:
Start the reporting workflow in response to an encounter-start event
When: Named Event: encounter-start
Check suspected disorders for immediate reportability and setup jobs for future reportability checks.
Then:
Check Trigger Codes based on Suspected Reportable and Lab Order Test Names Value set.
If: Applicability: (%suspectedDisorderEncounterDiagnosis.where(verificationStatus.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(entered-in-error|refuted)$')).exists().not() and (onset is null or (onset as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration or (onset as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration)).exists() or %suspectedDisorderConditions.where(verificationStatus.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(entered-in-error|refuted)$')).exists().not() and (onset is null or (onset as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration or (onset as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration)).exists() or %suspectedDisorderLabOrders.exists() or %suspectedDiagnosticOrders.exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%inProgressEncounterContinueCheck.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration >= now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours >= now())).select(true))
:
If: Applicability: (%terminatedencounter.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration < now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours < now())).select(true))
:
If: Applicability: (%lateCompletedEncounter.exists(status = 'finished') and ((%lateCompletedEncounter.where(class.code='AMB' or class.code='VR' or class.code='HH').exists() and %encounterEndDate + 1 day * %ambulatoryReportingDuration + 72 hours < now()) or (%lateCompletedEncounter.where(class.code='IMP' or class.code='EMER' or class.code='OBSENC').exists() and %encounterEndDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration + 72 hours < now())).select(true))
Check Reportability and setup jobs for future reportability checks.
Then:
Check Trigger Codes based on RCTC Value sets.
If: Applicability: ((%encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration >= now()) and (%conditions.where(verificationStatus.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(entered-in-error|refuted)$')).exists().not() and (onset is null or (onset as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration or (onset as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration)).exists() or %encounterDiagnoses.where(verificationStatus.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(entered-in-error|refuted)$')).exists().not() and (onset is null or (onset as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration or (onset as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration)).exists() or %medicationRequests.exists() or %medicationAdministrations.exists() or %medicationStatements.exists() or %diagnosticOrders.exists() or %diagnosticResults.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %diagnosticResultValues.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %encounters.exists() or %labOrders.exists() or %labTests.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %labResults.where((effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration) and (value as FHIR.CodeableConcept).coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and interpretation.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and ((value is FHIR.string).not() or ((value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('negative').not() and (value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('not detected').not()))).exists() or %labResultValues.where((effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration) and (value as FHIR.CodeableConcept).coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and ((value is FHIR.string).not() or ((value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('negative').not() and (value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('not detected').not()))).exists() or %immunizations.exists() or %negExemptLabResults.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %eltcLabResults.where((effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %extendedTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %extendedTimeboxDuration) and (value as FHIR.CodeableConcept).coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and interpretation.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and ((value is FHIR.string).not() or ((value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('negative').not() and (value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('not detected').not()))).exists()))
:
If: Applicability: (%lastReportSubmissionDate < now() - 72 hours)
:
If: Applicability: (%inprogressencounter.where((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration >= now() or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours >= now())).exists() and %inprogressencounter.where(class.code='IMP' or class.code='EMER' or class.code='OBSENC').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%ambinprogressencounter.where((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %ambulatoryReportingDuration >= now() or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours >= now())).exists() and %ambinprogressencounter.where(class.code='AMB' or class.code='VR' or class.code='HH').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%termencounter.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration < now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours < now())).exists() and %termencounter.where(class.code='IMP' or class.code='EMER' or class.code='OBSENC').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%termambencounter.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %ambulatoryReportingDuration < now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours < now())).exists() and %termambencounter.where(class.code='AMB' or class.code='VR' or class.code='HH').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%completedEncounter.exists(status = 'finished'))
Create eICR
Validate eICR
Route and send eICR
Start the reporting workflow in response to an encounter-modified event
When: Named Event: encounter-modified
Check Trigger Codes based on RCTC Value sets.
If: Applicability: (%modifiedConditions.where(verificationStatus.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(entered-in-error|refuted)$')).exists().not() and (onset is null or (onset as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration or (onset as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration)).exists() or %modifiedEncounterDiagnoses.where(verificationStatus.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(entered-in-error|refuted)$')).exists().not() and (onset is null or (onset as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration or (onset as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %dxTimeboxDuration)).exists() or %modifiedLabOrders.exists() or %modifiedLabTests.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %modifiedLabResults.where((effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration) and (value as FHIR.CodeableConcept).coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and interpretation.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and ((value is FHIR.string).not() or ((value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('negative').not() and (value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('not detected').not()))).exists() or %modifiedLabResultValues.where((effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration) and (value as FHIR.CodeableConcept).coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and ((value is FHIR.string).not() or ((value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('negative').not() and (value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('not detected').not()))).exists() or %modifiedDiagnosticResults.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %modifiedDiagnosticResultValues.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %modifiedImmunizations.exists() or %modifiedNegExemptLabResults.where(effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %labTimeboxDuration).exists() or %modifiedEltcLabResults.where((effective is null or (effective as FHIR.dateTime) >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %extendedTimeboxDuration or (effective as FHIR.Period).start >= %encounterStartDate - 1 day * %extendedTimeboxDuration) and (value as FHIR.CodeableConcept).coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and interpretation.coding.code.value.where(matches('^(260385009|260415000)$')).exists().not() and ((value is FHIR.string).not() or ((value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('negative').not() and (value as FHIR.string).lower().contains('not detected').not()))).exists())
